column4: S4.3: the codec hands its callees pointers into its own /GZ frame (f2c passes every scalar by address; codecDecodeFrame / codecEncodeFrame / codecAnalyzeFrame / codecVoicingDecision chain arrays of their frames, and two callees write outside the block they are given: c3bv.cpp header). ALL stack locals of the module sit behind ONE helper, `CodecFrame` (head of audio_codec.cpp): it reserves the original's frame + the saved ebp + the three /GZ pushes as S4.8's SndLocals (portsim/sim/audio_dev.h: the harness's entry esp when one is pending, else the frame block 0xFEB00000 + 64 KB, which grows down like a stack, so an out-of-block write lands in free stack below or in the caller's frame above, as in the original) and fills the frame with 0xcc as the prologue's `rep stosd` does; locals sit at the original's ebp offsets (fr.loc<T>(off)). Fifteen functions use it: codecDecodeFrame 0xac, codecEncodeFrame 0xa8, codecSynthesizeFrame 0x3e0, codecDecodeParams 0xbc, bitPermute 0x84, quantizeParams 0x78, codecAnalyzeFrame 0x5e0, lpcSynthesize 0x350, reflectionToLpc 0x80, interpSubframeParams 0xf8, codecLdlSolveClamped 0x208, codecAlignAnalysisWindow 0x80, codecVoicingDecision 0x11c, codecRefinePitchLag 0xa8, codecWindowFeatures 0xbc. No cell band in the image is used (the lead's suggestion): the deepest chain (codecEncodeFrame + codecAnalyzeFrame + codecVoicingDecision, 0x7a4 bytes of frames) and the out-of-block writes need more than the 0xf68 bytes of padding after .data. S4.2b had published no API when this step finished (log/roadmap/S4/2b_notes.md absent).

column4: S4.3: none of the 42 functions loads an x87 control word; each runs at its caller's. All 57 judging keys ran at 0x027f (Unicorn FPCW read as 0x023f, normalised), where the port's double arithmetic with the original's float spills equals the original on x64 and on Win32 (MSVC compiles Win32 doubles as SSE2 as well: port/CORE.md section 7). Under another caller word (the mixers leave 0x0f7f on the thread they run on: S4.4) every non-spilled intermediate would round to 64 bits instead of 53 and the port would differ. Which thread and word the game's callers of codecDecodeFrame (openMmioSound, rva 0x30840) and codecEncodeFrame (loadWaveResource, rva 0x316c0) run at is not determined by this step.
column5: measure the FPCW at the entry of codecDecodeFrame / codecEncodeFrame in a live game with sound (Frida, a game slot); if it is not 0x027f, the bodies need S4.4's x87 unit

column4: S4.3: the CRT leaves sqrt (0x43204), floor (0x4339c), log (0x432e4) and exp (0x432b0) and __ftol (0x42550) are computed inline (std::sqrt / floor / log / exp, ftol_low32), as the accepted S4 steps inline __ftol, not called through the dispatcher. sqrt and floor are exact at 0x027f. log / exp: the CPU's `fyl2x` / `f2xm1` keep a 64-bit result in st(0) that interpSubframeParams subtracts and multiplies before the `fstp dword` (0x3e084-0x3e0cf, 0x3e125-0x3e13f); the port rounds it to a double first (as the C3 hook c3br did, calling the CRT through a double return). Unicorn 2.1.4's fyl2x is itself a host-double computation (probe in this step: the low 11 significand bits of its result are 0 for 3.0, 0.7, 12345.678, 1.0000001). All 14 interpSubframeParams vectors are EXACT against the live CPU CSV (S4.1 census) and GREEN.

column4: S4.3: the bodies keep the hooks' structure: some loop counters and scratch values the original keeps in frame slots are host variables (bitPermute's counter at [ebp-0x40] = work slot 0, codecSynthesizeFrame's entry counter at [ebp-0x9c] = modeSlots slot 0, reflectionToLpc's inner j, codecWindowFeatures' `v` which shares [ebp-0x10] with the scratch cell). A callee or an index that wrote those slots would change the original's control flow and not the port's. Every array the original indexes in its frame is now in the frame (CodecFrame), so writes past an array's end reach the same neighbours; no vector reaches such a write (all keys GREEN, coverage log/roadmap/S4/3_coverage.tsv).
